description.value: Little Caesars is a national pizza chain franchise offering Hot-N-Ready and made-to-order pizzas in a carryout and delivery format. This Coquitlam location operates on a takeout-only model with no dine-in seating, making it a convenient stop for cyclists picking up a quick, affordable meal. The outlet carries the brand's full menu including pizza, Crazy Bread, and wings.

address.value: 1175 Johnson Street, Unit 220, Coquitlam, BC V3B 7K1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, open Little Caesars at 1175 Johnson St, #220, Coquitlam, BC, matching the OSM address and phone number. The OSM tag takeaway=only and website text 'Order carryout or delivery today' confirm takeout service. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cyclist amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags. A notable discrepancy: the OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the website and the postal address both place this location in Coquitlam.
concerns: OSM community field is set to 'North Vancouver' but the website and full postal address (V3B 7K1) place this location in Coquitlam, BC — these are different municipalities. The community/city metadata in OSM appears incorrect and should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food location confirmed by website. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking affordable takeout pizza.
